goal: Create a typed global store for a counter with increment, decrement and reset actions, and a component that shows the count and buttons, re-rendering only when the count changes.
Create a store for user preferences (theme and language) that is saved to localStorage and restored on reload, with a version number and a migration from an older shape.
Build one store out of two separately defined slices (a cart slice and a user slice) where an action in one slice can read the other, fully typed.
Write a component that reads two fields from a store as an object without causing extra re-renders when unrelated fields change.
Create a todo store whose actions update nested state by mutating a draft, with add, toggle and remove actions.
Create an async store that fetches a user profile, tracks loading and error state, and shows its actions in the browser devtools extension with action names.
Create a store that can be used outside React (from plain modules), subscribe to changes of one field only, and also read it inside a React component.
Create a store per component subtree (not a global singleton), initialised from props, provided through React context, with a typed hook to read it.
